title: Ordinary strict coefficient-system direct-image data
statement: For prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ and coefficient comparison data $C$ of [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models], OrdinaryStrictImageData consists of an additive functor $F$ from the strict coefficient systems on $X$ to those on $Y$, the evaluation isomorphisms $F e_{Y,n}\,\mathrm{model}_{Y,n}\cong e_{X,n}\,\mathrm{model}_{X,n}\,f_{n,*}$ which are identity on sections, and an ordinary natural isomorphism $F C_Y.\mathrm{systemRestriction}\cong C_X.\mathrm{systemRestriction}\,f_*^{\mathbf N^{op}}$ which is identity on underlying sections in each degree. It includes neither a derived image nor a derived comparison or acyclicity assertion. The site and coefficient universes are independent.

None specializes the ordinary section identities or restricted-system acyclicity to CompletedCoefficientPushforwardModels. The generic derived square is reused in the parent.
